softGroundMaxRadiusFrac.label: Soft Ground Max. Blast Radius
softGroundMaxRadiusFrac.description: Cap on how far a soft-ground crater spreads. A blast carves r/hardness, but the AABB clip turned the bigger soft-soil sphere into a square hole; this bounds the effective radius at SOFT_MAX*r so grass/dirt carve a round crater (rock is unchanged).
softGroundMaxRadiusFrac._source: blast.js HARDNESS FLOOR — the AABB-clip square-footprint bug fix: effective radius r*clamp(1/hardness,1,SOFT_MAX); the old unscaled AABB clipped the bigger soft-ground sphere into a square hole (~2.18x the voxels of the round rock crater). Bounded data so JS carries no literal; default 1.25 keeps soft craters only slightly larger than rock.
softGroundMaxRadiusFrac._note: Data-bounded scalar. hardness >= 1/SOFT_MAX is unchanged (rock hardness 1.0 stays byte-identical, round radius rCells); hardness below the floor is raised so the radius is capped at SOFT_MAX*r. The AABB loop bounds grow by the same SOFT_MAX (more cells TEST, fewer CARVE — net perf win; blast() runs once per impact, not per frame).

airViscosity.label: Air Viscosity
airViscosity.description: Whether air slows projectiles; with viscous air, ballistic guidance and some computer players misbehave.
airViscosity._dragKNote: W2-A (plan SE-COMPLETE-1012): per-unit linear drag coefficient — dv/dt = -viscosity * dragK * v (world u/s^2 per u/s). The manual (L1834-L1839) publishes no magnitude; data-bounded so JS carries no literal. viscosity 20 => k = 1.0/s. dragK 0 is FORBIDDEN (monotonicity pin in test/unit/physics-rest.test.js).

gravity.rangeNote: FPS-1012h: rescaled with the default (49 SE px/s^2 = 9.8 world) — the manual 0.05..10 band was in the same inconsistent units as the 0.2 default.

suspendDirt.label: Suspend Dirt

tanksFall.label: Tanks Fall

bordersExtend.label: Borders Extend
bordersExtend.description: How far off-screen projectiles are tracked before counting as a miss.

modes.CONCRETE: Blocks shots from going off screen in any direction.
modes.PADDED: Reflects shots but absorbs some energy first.
modes.SPRING: Like RUBBER but kicks the projectile on reflection, pinball-style.
modes.WRAP: Left/right edges wrap: off right, on left (manual: 'WRAPAROUND').
modes.RANDOM: Computer picks one of the above methods at the start of each round.
modes.ERRATIC: Computer picks a method before each shot.
modes.NONE: Walls have no effect (screen edges are gray).

impactDamage.label: Impact Damage
impactDamage.description: If on, tanks take damage from a fall when they hit the ground; if off, while falling. Total damage is the same either way (manual:L2156-L2161, Archaic Options — cfg-file analog). (Archaic Options menu in the OG — cfg-file analog.)

settleSequence._source: OG Scorched Earth: destruction first, ~500ms cartoon hold before dirt settles (physics don't apply immediately), then tanks fall and settle, then the fall damage phase, then death animations. holdSteps=30 sim steps = 500ms at fixedDt 1/60. Plan SETTLE-SEQUENCE-1014 (user directive 2026-10-14).
settleSequence._source_pace: SETTLE-PACE-1015 user verdict: everything too fast — visible dirt, lingering fx, camera waits.
settleSequence._source_remesh: CRATER-DRAIN: the per-sim-step render-mesh drain budget. A shell impact enqueues its dirtyChunks (v3d.enqueueRemesh) instead of building the whole crater render mesh in one frame (~0.06ms/chunk × ~2000 chunks ≈ 120ms = the freeze). settle3d drains a bounded slice each sim step behind the blast-sphere VFX that already grows over growSeconds(≈0.6)×fxTimeScale(1.8)≈1.08s≈65 sim steps: ~2000-chunk crater / 65 ≈ 32 chunks/step. The voxel collider is field-based (columnTop off field.cells, mutated synchronously by blast()), so ONLY the render mesh is deferred — collision is immediate the frame the shell lands.
settleSequence._remeshPerStepNote: KEPT as the count-cap reference (spec crater-drain reads it for the bounded-delta pin); the drain is now TIME-budgeted via remeshBudgetMs below, not chunk-count-bounded — remeshPerStep is no longer passed as the per-step drain count.

remeshBudgetMs.label: Crater Remesh Budget (ms)
remeshBudgetMs.description: Max milliseconds per sim step the deferred crater render-mesh drain may spend building queued chunks. TIME-bounded (not chunk-count-bounded) so the idle->0FPS frame spike can never recur regardless of how deep the pending queue gets; the queued crater still drains over successive steps.
remeshBudgetMs._source: CRATER-DRAIN PERF FIX (idle->0FPS killer): the per-sim-step drain was chunk-count-bounded (remeshPerStep=32), which spikes ~64-96ms in ONE frame when the pending queue is full (32 chunks × ~2-3ms). Replaced with a wall-time budget: settle3d builds queued chunks one at a time (drainRemesh(field,1)) while accumulating performance.now()-t1 < remeshBudgetMs, so the drain spends at most ~6ms/frame. The queued crater still drains across successive steps (bounded, deferred, collision-immediate) — only the pacing law changed (wall-time, not chunk count).

impact._source: Fall-impact damage magnitudes (manual:L2156-L2161 publishes NO numbers — the fall happens, the total is the same on/off). Drop measured in SE px (SE_PX_TO_WORLD anchor). Damage books through the single damage path (battleLoop.onBlast hostile) via the lightning strikePoint standoff.

buried._source: SETTLE-PACE-1015 user directive (option 1): dirt on top of a tank buries it — a tank is buried when surface − tank.y >= minCoverU (0.3u ≈ one 0.25u voxel + epsilon). Buried tanks cannot drive but can aim/fire; their own blasts carve the column and the tank falls free (fall damage per the existing .impact path when the carve over-deepens).

battle._source: Battle hull constant: every player starts at maxHull (S3D pin; battleLoop MAX_HULL / turnState hull / accessories repair cap all read here).
